title: MIN and MAX of a column with negatives, zeros and BLANKs
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "min", MIN ( V[N] ), "max", MAX ( V[N] ) )

source.quote: Returns the smallest value in a column, or between two scalar expressions.
Returns the largest value in a column, or between two scalar expressions.

derivation: V[N] holds 5, BLANK, 0, -3, 5, BLANK, 2. Smallest -3, largest 5.
